newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Zairean President Mobutu arrives in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Zairean President Mobutu arrives in Morocco.

text.p: Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko arrived in Morocco on Monday for a three-day working visit during which officials said he was expected to meet King Hassan.
Mobutu, who has been convalescing in France from prostate cancer surgery, was welcomed at Rabat airport by Moroccan Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali and other government officials, eyewitnesses said.
The Zairean president, wearing a blue suit and his trademark leopardskin hat, carried his traditional cane in his hand as he left his white private DC-8 jet. He made no statement.
An official said the Zairean leader was expected to have a first meeting with the king late on Monday and to leave for Zaire, where rebels hold an eastern region of the country, on Thursday.
In France, the veteran president's son and spokesman, Mobutu Nzanga, told Reuters on Saturday that Mobutu would spend the week in Morocco and fly home to Zaire next Saturday.
Since he underwent prostate surgery in Switzerland on August 22, Mobutu has spent most of his time in his palatial French Riviera residence at Roquebrune-Cap Martin.

He returned briefly to Zaire in December and ordered an army reorganisation to launch a counter-offensive against the rebels near the border with Rwanda and Uganda, but flew back to France last month for further medical checks.
